summary: 100-foot Wisconsin standard tower built September 1939 in Oneida County; listed as standing, long out of service, with no access record found.

facts.design: Wisconsin standard tower with an external protected ladder

events.note: Built September 1939 per the NHLR detail page; originally called Tomahawk Lake Lookout

evidence.supports: 100-foot Wisconsin standard tower with external protected ladder, built September 1939
evidence.quote: This 100-foot Wisconsin standard tower features an external protected ladder and was built in September, 1939.
Historical records indicate this tower was originally called Tomahawk Lake Lookout.

evidence.supports: administered by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources
never retrofitted with the cable fall-arrest system used on other DNR ladder towers
evidence.quote: The Lake Tomahawk Lookout was never retrofitted with the cable fall-arrest system found on other DNR ladder towers

evidence.supports: no active service in decades, as described on the register page (registered 2017)
hole in roof visible from ground; one missing floorboard in cab
evidence.quote: From the ground a large hole in the roof is visible along with one missing floorboard in the cab.

evidence.supports: orange paint likely marks an aerial hazard; half a mile from a private airfield
evidence.quote: Alternating segments of the tower frame and cab are painted orange, likely to identify it as an aerial hazard due to its close proximity (1/2 mile) to a private airfield.

evidence.supports: many Wisconsin towers still standing were built in the 1930s by CCC crews (general context; not confirmed for this tower)
evidence.quote: Many of the towers we see still standing today were built during the 1930s by the young men of the Civilian Conservation Corps.

evidence.supports: 72 towers still in use were decommissioned in 2015 (general; not confirmed for this tower)
evidence.quote: In 2015, the 72 aging towers still in use were decommissioned.

evidence.supports: listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association
evidence.quote: Lake Tomahawk Oneida 45.83561 -89.61024 Tower Standing NHLR US 1245, WI 40

sources.title: Connecting the dots: the fire towers of Wisconsin

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR detail page carries nearly all tower-specific facts, including a description that the tower has not been in active service for decades; that description is undated and I took 2017 (registration) as its as_of. A Clio entry for the tower was found but is a user draft, so it is not cited. The WJFW feature covers the 2015 decommissioning only in general terms, and the 2015 APG article (Price County Review) could not be fetched (HTTP 429). The name 'Tomahawk Lake Lookout' appears only as a historical name on the register; the record uses 'Lake Tomahawk Lookout'. Access and rental are not established; the story says so and advises against climbing. The register's damage description is the reason.
